title: Quiet play
idea: The bookmark stays the hero, with the app's own play button punched small through its optical centre. The icon says saved first and listen second.
built: Bookmark as p1: 42.5 dp wide, today's proportions, drawn box centred. The play has the proportions of the player's Lucide play (14 deep by 18 tall); its flat side is 15 units of 34 (18.75 dp), 36% of the bookmark's height, the smallest play a 48 px icon still shows without effort. Corners r 1.7 units, 0.11 of its height, the same softness as p1's play. The flat side sits 0.40 of the depth left of the centre line, close to centroid centring, because the eye places a small shape in a wide field by its mass. The axis is 17.6 units below the top: the centre of mass is at 18.4, but a small play there reads low. Walls: 12.3 units at the flat side, 11.4 at the tip, 11.5 above and 7.8 to the notch's apex. The hole is 6.6% of the bookmark.
small: 48 px: play 12 x 9.3 px on x 20, 10 px of paper at the flat side and 9.9 at the tip. 32 px: play 8.5 x 6.6 px on x 13, walls of 6 and 6.2 px. 16 px: the play in whole pixels as columns of 5, 3 and 1 on x 7, rows 5 to 9, the smallest shape that still reads as a play. Glyph: play 8.5 px tall on x 9, walls of 5 and 5.2 px. Every cut keeps the play; at 16 px it is as tall as p1's, as nothing smaller reads as a play.
risks: The least inventive of the three: a symbol set into the bookmark, close to clip art, kept clear of it only by its restraint. The play is small, so in the status bar and at 16 px it is a 5 px mark that can be taken for a speck, and on a busy home screen the listen message is easy to miss. It shares its play shape with p2.
